title: Intersections of quasi-compact opens
statement:
Let $X$ be a
quasi-separated scheme and
let $U,V\subset X$ be quasi-compact open subschemes. Then
$U\cap V$ is a quasi-compact open subscheme.

proof.text: By the finite-affine-cover theorem, each quasi-compact open U and V is a finite union of affine opens, say U = union_i U_i and V = union_j V_j.

The intersection U intersect V is the finite union of the opens U_i intersect V_j. Each U_i intersect V_j is quasi-compact by clause (1) of the affine-cover criterion for quasi-separatedness [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-separated-affine-cover-criterion], since X is quasi-separated and U_i, V_j are affine opens; finite unions of quasi-compact subsets are quasi-compact. Therefore U intersect V is quasi-compact; it is open because it is an intersection of opens.
